name: Disneyland Refreshment Corner (Main Street) Plain Footlong / Regular All-Beef Hot Dog & Chips
brandOrRestaurant: Refreshment Corner (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: A plain all-beef frankfurter on a soft white bun with potato chips or applesauce is dairy-free, citrus-free, and quick to mobile-order on Main Street.
